context.problemStatement: Show four eighths as half of a whole.
context.solutionStrategy: Use the quantities given in the problem.
context.groundingProse: Divide one bar into eight equal pieces, shade four pieces. Four eighths equals one half.

content.altText: A fraction bar divided into 8 equal parts with 4 parts shaded to show four eighths.

annotations.steps: I divide the fraction bar into eight equal parts and shade four of them.
annotations.strategy: I notice that shading four out of eight parts covers exactly half of the bar.
annotations.misconceptions: You might think four eighths is a different amount because the numbers are bigger, but it covers the exact same space as one half.
annotations.connections: This shows how different fractions can name the exact same amount, which helps us find equivalent fractions.
